en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing an interior exhibition or showroom packed with wicker and rattan furniture: armchairs, tables, baskets, baby cradles, and decorative household items. At the back hang woven textiles with folk-style geometric patterns. Several Bulgarian-language signs advertise a wickerwork studio, with the largest sign reading the proprietor's name. The scene looks like a trade fair orcraft display from the early 20th century.
